title: Our CEO on Micode’s Underscore_
summary: Geoff sits down with Micode on Underscore_ to talk forecasting, foundation models, and what we're building at The Forecasting Company.
body_markdown:
Our CEO[Geoff](https://www.linkedin.com/in/geoffrey-negiar/) joined[Micode](https://www.youtube.com/@Micode) on *Underscore* _ — one of France’s most-watched tech shows — to talk about why forecasting is overdue for a foundation-model rethink, and what we’re building at The Forecasting Company.


Want to know more?[Get in touch](https://www.theforecastingcompany.com/contact) .
